# FinePrint — fineprint.legal
> We read the fine print so you don't have to.

FinePrint is a free AI-powered tool that analyzes Terms of Service and Privacy Policies in plain English. Users can paste a URL, paste text directly, or upload a document (.txt, .pdf, .docx) and receive a letter-graded breakdown of what they're agreeing to.

## Key Features
- Letter grade scoring (A+ through F) based on weighted criteria
- 7-section analysis: data collection, data practices, rights surrendered, exit difficulty, red flags, and bottom line
- URL fetching: paste any URL to a company's TOS page
- File upload support: .txt, .pdf, .docx
- Risk badges (LOW / MEDIUM / HIGH) on every clause
- Pre-analyzed company pages with searchable index
- 15 educational guides explaining common legal concepts
- Share system with dynamic OG image generation
- Hall of Fame for companies with B- or higher grades
- Wall of Shame for user-submitted problematic policies

## Important Disclaimers
- FinePrint is NOT a law firm and does NOT provide legal advice
- All analysis is educational and informational only
- AI analysis may contain errors or miss important nuances
- Always consult a qualified attorney for legal decisions

## Pages
- / — Homepage with analysis tool
- /about — About FinePrint
- /company — Index of analyzed companies
- /company/[slug] — Individual company analysis (13 companies)
- /guides — Educational guides about TOS concepts
- /guides/[slug] — Individual guide (15 guides)
- /how-we-grade — Grading methodology, criteria, and FAQ
- /hall-of-fame — Companies with B- or higher grades
- /wall-of-shame — User-submitted problematic policies
- /privacy — Privacy policy
- /terms — Terms of service
- /disclaimer — Legal disclaimer

## Analyzed Companies (13)
- ChatGPT/OpenAI (C-), DecipherDocs.com (B-), Design.com (C-), Discord (C-)
- Facebook/Meta (D+), Google (C-), Instagram (C-), LinkedIn (C-)
- Reddit (D+), Spotify (D+), TikTok (D+), Uber (D-), X/Twitter (D-)
